name: Broccoli Supreme
description: A chilled broccoli salad with raisins, bacon, and a creamy cheese dressing.
recipeIngredient: 6 or 8 slices bacon, cooled and crumbled

recipeInstructions.text: Beat dressing ingredients until smooth.
Add dressing to broccoli, raisins, and onion. Cover and chill at least 3 hours.
Sprinkle with bacon and serve.

_similar.name: Bacon Broccoli Salad
_similar.description: A hearty broccoli salad with crispy bacon, red onion, and a tangy dressing featuring low-fat yogurt and feta cheese.

recipeInstructions.text: Combine the broccoli, red onion, sunflower seeds, raisins, and crumbled bacon in a large salad bowl.
In a separate bowl, mix together the yogurt, mayonnaise, sugar, and lemon juice to make the dressing.
Pour the dressing over the salad ingredients and toss to coat.
Refrigerate for 2 hours to allow the flavors to meld.

_similar.name: Supreme Broccoli Soup Casserole
_similar.description: A creamy broccoli casserole with a crunchy crouton topping, baked until golden.

recipeInstructions.text: Place cooked broccoli in a 9x9 inch pan.
Mix together mushroom soup, flour, sour cream, and seasonings. Pour over broccoli.
Sprinkle grated carrot, chopped onion, and croutons over the top.
Drizzle with melted butter.
Bake at 325°F for 1/2 hour.

_similar.name: Fresh Broccoli Mandarin Salad
_similar.description: A refreshing salad featuring fresh broccoli, mandarin oranges, mushrooms, and a rich, creamy dressing with a hint of mustard.
recipeIngredient: 1 egg plus 1 egg yolk, slightly beaten
½ medium red onion, sliced into rings

recipeInstructions.text: In the top of a double boiler, whisk together the egg, egg yolk, sugar, cornstarch, and mustard.
Slowly whisk in the vinegar and water mixture, then cook over hot water, stirring constantly, until the dressing thickens.
Remove from heat and stir in the softened butter and mayonnaise. Chill the dressing.
Just before serving, combine the crumbled bacon, mushrooms, almonds, mandarin oranges, red onion, and broccoli in a large salad bowl.
Add the chilled dressing and toss to coat the salad ingredients evenly.
Refrigerate any leftovers.

_similar.keywords: broccoli mandarin salad, creamy dressing, fresh salad

_similar.name: Broccoli Casserole
_similar.description: A classic broccoli casserole with a cheesy, soup-based sauce and a crunchy topping.
recipeIngredient: Butter and bread crumbs or fried onions for topping

recipeInstructions.text: Partially cook broccoli and drain. Place in a large casserole dish.
Mix together Cheez Whiz, cream of chicken soup, mushroom soup, and cooked rice. Pour over broccoli.
Bake at 350°F for 30 to 40 minutes.
Top with butter and bread crumbs or a can of fried onions before serving.

_similar.keywords: broccoli casserole, cheesy casserole, comforting main dish
